name: H-FROBENIUS-PAIR-CORRELATION-GUE
domain: Arithmetic Monodromy & Montgomery-Odlyzko GUE Spectral Bridge

hypotheses.description: Short-range level repulsion: As s -> 0, the unfolded pair correlation R_2(s) of Frobenius angles of cubic Artin-Schreier curves x^3 + ax over F_q exhibits quadratic suppression R_2(s) < 0.60 for s in [0.0, 0.2] across prime moduli q > 200, strictly ruling out uncorrelated Poisson statistics (where R_2(s) == 1.0).

GUE Correlation Agreement: For s in [0.5, 1.5], the root-mean-square deviation between empirical R_2(s) and Montgomery-Odlyzko GUE curve 1 - (sin(pi*s)/(pi*s))^2 is strictly smaller than the deviation from Poisson flat noise: RMSD(GUE) < RMSD(Poisson).
Asymptotic Poisson Recovery for Large Spacing: For large unfolded spacing s in [2.5, 4.0], R_2(s) converges to the mean background density |R_2(s) - 1.0| <= 0.35 across moduli q >= 300.

Non-trivial Spectral Form Factor Dip: The discrete Fourier transform (spectral form factor K(tau)) of unfolded Frobenius angles displays the characteristic GUE 'correlation hole' / dip K(tau) < 0.85 for small tau in (0, 0.5), ruling out uncorrelated random matrix ensembles.

methodology.computation: Statevector-First exact exponential sum arithmetic over F_q
methodology.pair_correlation: Double-sum over distinct pairs normalized by N and bin width ds
